What to look for: SV_DispatchThreadID is an integral semantic, but here it is
declared as float. All three compilers see the same invalid input; only DXC
fails to say so.

  FXC   error X4555: invalid type used for 'SV_DispatchThreadID' input
        semantics, must be integral
  Clang error: attribute 'SV_DispatchThreadID' only applies to a field or
        parameter of type 'uint/uint2/uint3'
  DXC   error: cast<X>() argument of incompatible type!
        -- an internal LLVM assertion message, not an HLSL diagnostic.

Both the predecessor and the successor already emit the right diagnostic, so
this is a missing diagnostic in DXC rather than a disputed language rule.

Change the parameter to uint3 and it compiles cleanly everywhere. float2,
float3 and float4 all fail exactly as float does, despite the issue title.
